user.title: Set up Alexa Bridge Manager
user.description: Enter the credentials of your Alexa Smart Home skill (Alexa Developer Console → Smart Home → Account Linking).

custom_endpoint.title: Custom event gateway
custom_endpoint.description: Enter the full URL of the Alexa event gateway.

error.invalid_client_id: The client ID does not have the expected format (should start with 'amzn1.application-oa2-client.').
error.invalid_client_secret: The client secret does not have the expected format (should start with 'amzn1.oa2-cs.v1.').
error.invalid_endpoint: The endpoint URL must start with https://.

abort.already_configured: This Alexa skill connection is already configured.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Alexa Bridge Manager instance is supported.

init.title: Manage exposed entities
init.description: Pick a domain to review its entities, or finish to save your changes.

entities_page.title: {domain} (page {page}/{total_pages})
entities_page.description: Toggle which entities are exposed to Alexa and optionally set a custom Alexa name. Leave the name empty to use the entity's Home Assistant name.

error.duplicate_names: Some Alexa names are used more than once, Alexa cannot tell them apart: {duplicates}

smart_home_conflict.title: Alexa Smart Home endpoint already in use
smart_home_conflict.description: Home Assistant already has a manual `alexa: smart_home:` block in configuration.yaml, which claims the same endpoint this integration needs. Remove that block from configuration.yaml (you can keep other `alexa:` sections such as `flash_briefings`), restart Home Assistant, then reload the Alexa Bridge Manager integration.
